detail.title: Proposal to Park Active Projects to Resolve Capacity Blockage
detail.summary: In accordance with proposal constraints and project capacity rules, all three active project slots are currently full while attention rotation requires substantive work on the unassigned_problem topic. To enable compliance and proper queue management under search slot limitations, this proposal parks the existing active project p-question-abandonment-001.
